lines: I, Wes Allen, Secretary of State of the State of Alabama, having custody Of the
Great and Principal Seal of said State, do hereby certify that
in accordance with the Code of Alabama, 1975, as amended, the following names are
certified by the Office of the Secretary of State as independent candidates in the General
Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
Alabama State House of Representatives, District 7
Alabama State House of Representatives, District 7
Alabama State House Of Representatives, District 35
Alabama State House of Representatives, District 65
In Testimony Whereof, I have hereunto set my hand
and affixed the Great Seal of the State, at the Capitol,
in the City of Montgomery, on this day.
